answer: An RF-planning-style identity vault assigns each agent a licensed band keyed to a physical coverage cell, so duplicate registrations collide like co-channel interference and get flagged. Admission uses a saffron-tagged link budget: each identity must clear a received-signal threshold from distinct cell sites, costing attackers real spectrum leases and site fees per sybil. This trellis of overlapping cells caps forgery at the interference floor, though dense urban reuse limits discrimination.
